You have to be careful dual booting with win 8+...I learned the hard way. They introduced some changes to the way it handles the filesystem- if you leave all options stock and access the drive with another OS, win 8+ will silently flip out the next time it boots.

Reason is when it boots, it writes some change to a config file. When you shut down, it does not write this change back to what other OS's expect, so they see some error and "fix" it, but then win 8+ boots back up and doesn't see what it expects. This resulted in some tedious trial and error permissions fixing to get my profile working correctly again.

You can avoid this by disabling the fast startup (or similar, don't remember the exact name) option...From somewhere, in some settings menu. This will force it to change the config file back to default when shut down.
